en.headline: Citybus driver suspended after Wong Chuk Hang crash injures five
en.dek: A Citybus lost control while descending Nam Fung Road on Friday evening, colliding with three other vehicles and injuring the driver and four passengers.
body: Police and emergency crews responded after a double-decker Citybus travelling downhill on Nam Fung Road lost control near the junction with Wong Chuk Hang Road at about 8:35pm on Friday, triggering a four-vehicle collision.

The bus, operating route 41A towards Wah Fu (Central), veered into oncoming lanes, struck roadside railings and came into contact with a taxi, a private car and a residential shuttle bus. The driver and four passengers sustained minor injuries and were taken conscious to Queen Mary Hospital.

Citybus said the company had immediately suspended the driver from duty. A spokesperson expressed sympathy for the injured and said the operator was treating the incident seriously and cooperating fully with police, who are investigating the cause.
Dashcam footage circulating online showed the bus descending the slope before crossing into opposing traffic and scattering debris. No other serious injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 黃竹坑城巴落斜失控撞三車 五人受傷車長暫停職務
zh.dek: 周五晚上約八時半，一輛城巴沿南風道落斜時懷疑失控，越過對面行車線並撞及鐵欄及三輛車輛，車長及四名乘客受傷。
body: 警方及救援人員在周五晚上約八時三十五分接報，一輛雙層城巴沿南風道落斜，駛至黃竹坑道交界附近時懷疑失控，釀成四車相撞。
涉事巴士為往華富（中）方向的41A線，越過對面行車線後撞毀路旁鐵欄，並波及的士、私家車及屋苑穿梭巴士。車長及四名乘客受輕傷，神智清醒，送往瑪麗醫院治理。
城巴表示已即時暫停涉事車長的駕駛職務，並向傷者致以慰問。發言人指公司嚴肃跟進事件，並全力配合警方調查事故原因。
網上有行車紀錄儀片段顯示巴士落斜時突然駛入對面行車線，現場有零件飛散。警方正調查意外經過。
